rationale.campaign_length: 本地H76任务文件含48项直接任务，收复西段后再解锁第二幕。
rationale.colonization: 开门后要重占荒废通道和矿堡，具地下殖民节奏而非跨海殖民。
rationale.complexity: 粗糙度与光泽度切换、停滞灾难、阶层反扑、殖民和贸易战并行。
rationale.dark_story: 包含孤立、围攻、政治清洗倾向和霸权战争，也有解放封闭居民与重建故事。
rationale.difficulty: 早期节奏、反叛与殖民资源牵制，后期还需多区域扩张。
rationale.diplomacy: 需要地表贸易和部分矮人关系，但霸权更依赖内政与战争。
rationale.early_pressure: 虽有存续矿堡，开门改革会遭遇停滞和守旧者压力。
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: 任务把钻石、精密器具和传奇宝石用于工程及防卫，但不是纯施法国家。
rationale.narrative_density: 两位钻石女王、封闭法令、守旧派、改革和帝国王冠串成两幕故事。
rationale.tall_play: 钻石矿井、工坊、矿堡深层与相邻旧堡修复是核心阶段。
rationale.trade_economy: 宝石匠行会、矿产增产、价格控制与红宝石堡竞争构成持续经济线。
rationale.warfare: 从矿堡夺回蛇脊西段，再争夺中部和旧帝国王座。

identity.appearance: 1444年已存在的钻石矮人矿堡；符合条件的冒险团在H76不存在时也可通用形成

successors.relationship: 满足通用条件时可选改Tag；专属剧情也可放弃形成并保留H76

national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text:
穿越宝石边境的洞穴之旅，无疑会发现几个巨大的圆形竖井穿透岩石，到达前所未见的深处：这些是由古老的凝固岩浆形成的金伯利岩脉，类似于高大的垂直管道，钻石就是从这里开采出来的。人们可以听到竖井边缘沉重的空气中巨大升降机的磨削声，同时可以看到几十座临时搭建的和宏伟的桥梁在竖井之间分隔开来。熙熙攘攘的车间环绕着轴，利用一个复杂的滑轮系统来上下移动货物。

一旦矿脉被清理干净，富有进取心的矮人们很快就利用现有的采矿基础设施来建造他们的家园和商店。
description.text_en:
A journey through the cavernous hold of Arg-Ôrdstun will no doubt reveal several massive, circular shafts piercing the rock to depths unseen: These are kimberlite veins of ancient, solidified magma that resemble tall, vertical pipes and from which diamonds are mined. One can hear the grinding of great lifts in the heavy air along the edge of the shafts and see the dozens of bridges, both makeshift and grand, that cleave the empty space between the clast shafts. Bustling workshops ring the shafts, taking advantage of a complex pulley system to move goods up and down.

Once the veins were cleared out, enterprising dwarves quickly took advantage of the existing mining infrastructure to build their homes and shops.

name.text: 宝石边境的大岩屑竖井

description.text: 宝石边境的宝石匠因彼此之间的顽固争斗而臭名昭著，他们通过完善钻石切割技术以争取君主的青睐。然而，国家赞助的格罗姆达尔行会的形成，旨在弥补这一点，巩固和重新引导宝石边境工匠的能量一致向外。他们著名的钻石遍布矮人之地的各个角落，装饰着珠宝和仪式武器，与其他领地的工艺相辅相成。
description.text_en: The lapidaries of Arg-Ôrdstun were infamous for stubbornly feuding with each other, to perfect their diamond gemcutting techniques to gain the favour of their ruler. The formation of the state-sponsored Gromdhal guild however aimed to remedy that, consolidating and redirecting the energies of the Diamond artisans outward. Their famous diamonds reached all of the ends of the Dwarovar, adorning jewellery and ceremonial weaponry to complement the crafts of other holds.

name.text: 建立格罗姆达尔宝石匠行会
name.text_en: Formation of the Gromdhal Lapidary Guild

description.text: 数千年前，在矮人与憎恨太阳的洞穴地精无休止的战斗中，光耀盔甲首次投入使用。它镶有数十上百颗精心制作的碎钻，不仅坚硬无比，而且可以将光线直接反射到洞穴黑暗中可能伏击者的眼睛里，在愚蠢到冲进矮人前线的敌人中播撒不协调的种子。后来，将军们用这种做法发展了进攻战术，以对付他们遇到的所有种族，保持这种古老和简单的技术相关。
description.text_en: First used millennia ago during the endless skirmishes against the sun hating cave goblins, lightflare armour is embedded with dozens of diamonds. This diamond-studded armour was carefully crafted and warded to reflect light directly into the eyes of any would-be ambushers from the dark of the caverns, sowing discord in the ranks of enemies foolish enough to charge into a frontline of dwarves standing resolute with lightflare armour. Later generals developed offensive tactics with this practice relevant against all races they encountered, keeping this ancient and simple technique relevant.

description.text: 雕琢得如此巧妙以至于这颗巨大的宝石的中心似乎吸引光并随着光的脉动而跳动，埃吉斯是宝石边境的皇冠宝石。据说，凝视它深处太长时间的人会产生奇怪的精神影响。不管这些影响是真实的还是想象的，钻石的存在已经在许多外交谈判中为宝石边境的领导人服务得很好。随着建立一个统一矮人帝国的呼声越来越高，宝石边境承诺支持，埃吉斯被放弃，成为众矮人之国的矮人之冠宝石，只是为了在未来自己寻求戴上这顶王冠。
description.text_en: Faceted so masterfully that the massive gem's very center seems to draw in and pulsate with light, the Aegis was the crown jewel of the Arg-Ôrdstun. It is said to have strange mental effects on those who gaze for too long into its depths. Whether those effects are real or imagined, the presence of the diamond has served the leaders of Arg-Ôrdstun well in many diplomatic negotiations. As the clamour for a united dwarven empire grew and Arg-Ôrdstun pledged support, the Aegis was forfeited to adorn the Dwarovkron, only for them to seek to wear the crown in the future themselves.

description.text: 我们曾经控制了整个蛇境，从锁木之门的深木堡垒到大理石门的伟大大理石陵墓，甚至到叛逆的、焦黑的火顶山大厅。为了挑战议会之门的绝对统治，对领地的霸权是优先考虑的，因为我们的自然权利不仅延伸到蛇境，而且延伸到众矮人之国。
description.text_en: Our hold once held sway over the entirety of the Serpentreach, from the deepwoods bulwark of Verkal Skomdihr, to the great marble mausoleums of Shazstundihr, and even to the rebellious, blackened halls of Gor Bûrad. Hegemony over the holds was a priority in order to challenge the absolute rule of Amldihr, as our natural right extend not only to the Serpentreach but also to Aul-Dwarov.

description.text: 血腥宝石之战是我们历史上的一个重大事件，由于红宝石被引入到矮人之冠，宝石边境国王起兵反抗众矮人之国的至高王，议会之门傲慢地引入一颗外来的宝石是不可容忍的。这一行为导致了一场残酷的内战，摧毁了矮人之地，并令我们的国王被流放，但议会之门的至高王死了。他们的背叛永远不会被原谅，我们的历史事业将被视为正义。
description.text_en: The War of the Bloody Gem was a major event in our history where the Diamond King rebelled against the High King of Aul-Dwarov, due to the introduction of the Ruby Gem to the Dwarovkron. The arrogance of Amldihr to introduce a gem of outsiders was intolerable This act caused a brutal civil war which devastated the Dwarovar and left our king exiled, but the High King of Amldihr dead. Their betrayal will never be forgiven and our historical cause will be seen as righteous.

description.text: 在众矮人之国早期，统治时间长达一百五十多年的哈尔克拉兹女王被其领民称为「反抗者」，被其同僚称为「讨厌鬼」。为了争论至高王的权威，哈尔克拉兹不知疲倦地领导着至高会议的主要反对派。她是宝石边境利益至上的坚定捍卫者，在她的统治期间通过至高议会推行了许多有益的政策。
description.text_en: Known as 'the Defiant' to her subjects and 'the Irksome' to her peers, Queen Halkraz reigned for over 150 years during the early days of Aul-Dwarov. Clashing with the authority of the High King, Halkraz dedicated her life to tirelessly leading the main opposition in the High Assembly. She was a staunch champion for the interests of Arg-Ôrdstun above all else and pushed many beneficial policies through the Amlharaz during her rule.

name.text: 女王「反抗者」哈尔克拉兹的遗产
name.text_en: Legacy of Queen Halkraz the Defiant

description.text:
矮人之冠是象征矮人诸族团结一致的最为伟大之物。它的冠带由克罗尼姆，一种为锻成矮人之冠、成为现存最为沉重金属而专门熔炼而成的合金所铸就，其目的是以物理手段展示统治与规则的重量。

嵌于冠带之上的是七颗属于矮人之冠的伟大宝石：南域之门的黄水晶、宝石边境的钻石、翠玉矿都的翠玉、暗望所的蓝宝石、阿斯拉领地的玛瑙、酒匠大厅的紫水晶和瑰红居所——通常被称作红宝石领的红宝石。虽然矮人之冠上的确也装饰着其他不同的宝石，但总的来说，它们都无法与这七颗璀璨瑰宝中的任何一颗相比；而每一颗宝石的光辉在整座冠冕的威严面前也都显得苍白。
description.text_en:
The Dwarovkron is the greatest symbol of Dwarven Unity. It is forged of Kronium, a metal artificially created for the crown, with the specific purpose of being the heaviest metal in existence to physically drive home the weight of rule.

Adorning it are the seven great gems of the Dwarovkron: the Citrine of Seghdihr, the Diamond of Arg-Ôrdstun, the Jade of Grônstunad, the Sapphire of Dûr-Vazhatun, the Agate of Ovdal Asra, the Amethyst of Hul-az-Krakazol, and the Ruby of Ovdal Vudi -- more commonly known as Rubyhold. While other gems do appear on the crown, collectively they all fail to compare to the majesty of even a single of these brilliant stones. And each single stone pales before the majesty of the entire crown.

description.text: 在众矮人之国陷落之前，她的军队是根据国王的命令召集的。在至高议会上的每个领地都要维持自己的常备军，以保卫领地防御工事以外的领土，在矮人线上巡逻，并在至高王征召时保护帝国。当需要在多条战线上作战时，至高王通常会根据需要将部分军队委派给秘银地国王、羊爵之门国王或西山驿将军国王，无论谁佩戴矮人王冠，他们对国王的忠诚和承诺都是绝对的。
description.text_en: Before the fall of Aul-Dwarov, her armies were called to banner, or muster, by writ of the High King and the High King alone. Each hold seated on the Amlharaz was to maintain its own standing force to see to the defence of the holds' territories beyond its fortifications, to patrol the Dwarovrod, and to protect the Empire whenever mustered by the High King. When times called for multiple fronts to be fought, the High King would traditionally delegate portions of the armies to either the King of Mithradhûm, the King of Orlazam-az-dihr, or the General-King of Gor Vazumbrog as needed, their loyalty and commitment to the High King being absolute no matter who wore the Dwarovkron.

effects.display: 附庸提供的军队数量上限：+50%
effects.label_zh: 附庸提供的军队数量上限

description.text: 要在蛇脊山脉建造一座领地，在不同程度上需要三个必要条件。首先是丰富的资源——大量的矿石和矿物，既能支持现场的建设工作，又能用于出口贸易，以采购任何缺失的材料。其次是对易守难攻的家园的需求，但其防御能力远远超过任何普通城市。第三是时间：一旦最初的居住区建成，需要花费数十年的时间进行规划。下水道、通风设备、住宅区、人车通行隧道、农场等等。然后，几个世纪一寸一寸地慢慢凿去石头，这才是人们认为的建造、领地的艺术。尽管历史上建造了许多领地，但没有一座比团结一致的众矮人之国所建造的领地更宏伟。
description.text_en: To build a hold in the Serpentspine requires three necessities in varying degrees. The first is an abundance of resources -- vast quantities of ores and minerals to both support the construction efforts on site, and to export for trade in order to procure any missing materials. Second is a perceived need for an easily defensible home, but with defences well beyond any normal city. The third is time: A proper hold takes decades of planning once the original settlement is constructed. Sewers, ventilation, residential districts, access tunnels for foot and cart traffic, farms, and more. Then, centuries of slowly chiselling away stone, inch by inch, to merely scratch the surface of what one could consider the art of creating a hold. Although many holds were built throughout history, none were more grand than the ones created by a united Aul-Dwarov.

description.text:
「统一者」乌德瑞克被视为议会之门的第一任至高王，尽管他生前从未真正拥有过这个头衔。乌德雷克利用他的前任对附近领地的新兴地方霸权（通过巧妙利用蛇谷灌溉系统而获得），将其转化为更大的影响力。

由于北面和西面有冰霜巨人的威胁，东面又有火巨人的威胁，乌德雷克在灰元前18109年召集了几位北蛇脊山脉的国王：阿斯拉城的巴尔格林四世·阿斯拉、命运堡的「隐者」达格兹乌尔特和至高领主之地的科格瑞克二世·钢铁之手，以确保蛇谷的安全，进而促进矮人的繁荣。每一位国王都在特定条件下宣誓效忠议会之门的乌德瑞克，例如稳定而廉价的蛇谷谷物销售渠道、像保卫自己的领地一样保卫每一个领地的义务，以及最重要的选举至高王的前身——所有矮人的加冕捍卫者。
description.text_en:
Udrek the Consolidator was seen as the first High King of Amldihr despite never actually holding the title during his lifetime. Udrek had leveraged his predecessor's burgeoning local hegemony over the nearby holds (earned via clever use of the Serpent's Vale irrigation system) into something more substantial.

With the threat of the Frost Giants to the north and west, and the Fire Giants to the east, in 18,109 BA Udrek gathered several kings of the Northern Serpentspine: Balgrin IV Asra of Ovdal Asra, Dagzvult "the Cryptic'' of Verkal Kozenad, and Kogrik II Steelhand of Haraz Orldhûm in an effort to secure the safety of the Serpent's Vale, and by extension the prosperity of dwarvenkind. Each king swore fealty to Udrek of Amldihr under specific conditions, such as stable and cheap access to the sale of Serpent's Vale grains, an obligation to defend each hold as if they were their own, and most importantly the predecessor to the elective position of High King -- Crowned Defender of All Dwarvenkind.

description.text:
昔日众矮人之国声称统治着蛇脊山脉间的每一座洞穴，但这种「统治」说白了也是一触即断的脆弱之物。而尽管有着如宝石边境的钻石矿和琉璃领主之地的钴蓝矿这种珍贵的大洞穴，但众矮人之国也从未做出真正和具有针对性的努力，尝试完全控制矮人线附近的诸多洞穴。

正如我们今天所知，这是一个严重的错误：领地之间的联系因此很容易被切断，而让蛇脊山脉的大部分地区处于管辖之外则加剧了古众矮人之国的衰落。通过在今日纠正这一错误，我们确保这种情况永远不会再次发生。
description.text_en:
Though the dwarves of past Aul-Dwarov claimed dominion over the caves of the Serpentspine, in truth that grasp was always tenuous. Though there were great cavern holdings like the Diamond Mines of Arg-Ôrdstun, and the Cobalt Mines of Orlghelovar, no true directed effort was ever made to wrest full control of the many caverns adjoining the Dwarovrod.

This, as we know today, was a grave mistake: contact between holds could be easily severed, and leaving so much of the Serpentspine outside its rule exacerbated the decline of old Aul-Dwarov. By righting this wrong today, we ensure it can never happen again.

description.text: 古老的众矮人之国曾铸就了诸多世上前所未有的奇观，在它陷落后，无数人认为这些奇观将永不复返——因为矮人们要么已经成为曾是自己家园的土地上的囚奴，或是被迫逃亡地表，变为终其一生再无目睹故乡领地机会的流浪民族。但众矮人之国已被重锻为一，而那些古老的奇迹也确凿无疑地纷纷再现于世，甚至辉煌得更胜往昔：从秘银地庞大的真银熔炉，到交轨大厅壮观的铁道调系场和火炮城宏伟的铸炮兵工厂，我们将看到前人创造的奇迹被推向一个个新的高度。
description.text_en: Ancient Aul-Dwarov once created wonders the world had never seen before, and after its fall many thought they would never be seen again, as our people had become prisoners in their own domain, or surface exiles who never knew hearth and hold. But Aul-Dwarov has been reforged, and now we can indeed see those ancient wonders and restore them even beyond their prior glory. From the mighty mithril forges of Mithradhûm, to the great rail yards of Er-Natvir and the mighty cannon foundries of Ovdal Kanzad, we shall see the wonders of those who came before us driven to new heights.

description.text:
某种程度而言，至高王扮演的角色是一个真正矮人的典范。他必须如同最为坚实的磐石那般，坚定不移地做出决断，以庇护众矮人之国免受境外而来的风暴侵袭。他必须睿智、灵活和富有理解力地听取一干下级国王的建议，明了正是那些昔日的同僚构成了自己统治的基石。他必须肩负起统治的重担——佩于头顶、重如山岳的矮人之冠总是最为简单明了地提醒着这一点。最重要的是，他必须用智慧统治——因为当矮人忽视智慧，他们的团结就会出现裂痕。

这一点的最大证据便是「血腥宝石之战」——时任至高王鲁莽而草率地决定将红宝石镶嵌在矮人之冠上，没有经过至高议会的决断，后来也没有补偿那些被轻视而怒火中烧的领地，最终令众矮人之国陷入了数千年来前所未有的血腥内战。让我们确保这种危险的错误永远不会重演。
description.text_en:
The Role of the High King is, in a way, emblematic of the archetypal dwarf. He must be resolute in decision-making, the firm rock that shelters Aul-Dwarov from the storm that lay beyond his realm. He must be willing to listen to the advice provided by his lesser kings, showing flexibility and understanding, knowing that his rule was determined by those who used to be his peers. He must carry the weight of rule on his shoulders -- with the Dwarovkron a constant reminder. Above all else, he must rule with wisdom -- for when wisdom is ignored, dwarven unity is broken.

The greatest example of this is the War of the Bloody Gem, when the Ruby Gem was added to the Dwarovkron without consideration of the Amlharaz or compensation for the slighted holds afterwards, plunging Aul-Dwarov into its bloodiest civil war in millennia. Let us ensure that such a perilous mistake is never made again.

player_overview.avoid_if: 不想应付早期停滞、贵族反扑、殖民瓶颈与多阶段战争的玩家。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 前期破除孤立并稳住改革，中期修复矿堡与经营宝石贸易，后期利用光泽度和征服争夺矮人霸权。
player_overview.overview: 你以仍在坚守的钻石矮人矿堡开局，跟随改革女王废除隔绝法令，顶住贵族与行会的反扑。先重建蛇脊西段的旧堡和宝石贸易，再把钻石工艺、政治改革和王冠野心推向整个矮人世界。国家从令人窒息的‘粗糙度’走向可主动运用的‘光泽度’，但每次打磨都可能伴随叛乱与新战争。
player_overview.recommended_for: 喜欢矮人复兴、改革阻力、宝石经济和长线地下扩张的玩家。
signature_features: 从高粗糙度的守旧政府，逐步转为能积累并花费光泽度的改革政府。
宝石匠行会、矿堡生产与对红宝石堡的商业战贯穿扩张。
专属任务分两幕展开：先复兴蛇脊西段，再争夺整个矮人世界的霸权。
player_overview.tagline: 打开封闭六千年的钻石矿堡，把顽固的旧霸主打磨成新的矮人帝国。
